ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area estimated at approximately 85-90%, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in focal patches, linear streaks, and along the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) clusters are concentrated at the distal tip of the left lobe, the base of the median notch, and scattered as stochastic speckling and linear streaks across the interior regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 60-70 degrees and a deep vertical bounding box depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations visible along the entire boundary; significant jagged indentations on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing edge of both lobes leading to sharply tapered, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe; smaller scattered white circular points distributed across the ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the primary dark pigmentation; most prominent in the medial and lateral zones of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue irregularity and high-contrast scarring at the left distal tip; widespread linear rake marks consistent with interspecific or intraspecific interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Focal high-intensity white patch located at the exact apex of the median notch.
